description: Schedule C loss netting: single, wages $200,000, K-1 income $400,000, a $100,000 nonpassive rental loss (QBI loss in qbiLossOffset), and a $20,000 prior-year QBI loss carryforward. Listed: business 2 = $300,000 (W-2 wages $200,000), business 3 = the −$100,000 rental (its W-2 wages $50,000 do not count). Main = $400,000 − $300,000 − ($100,000 − $100,000) = $100,000 (W-2 wages $100,000). Taxable income before QBI: $200,000 + $400,000 − $100,000 − $15,750 = $484,250, past the range. Losses (line 3) $100,000 + $20,000 = $120,000; income (line 4) $400,000; netted $120,000, apportioned by QBI: main $30,000 → $70,000, business 2 $90,000 → $210,000. Components: main 20% = $14,000 (wage limit $50,000); business 2 $42,000 (wage limit $100,000). Total $56,000; overall limit 20% × $484,250 = $96,850. Nothing carries to next year.
